findings.summary: P1: external-agent-implementation-authority.ts only invokes bound recorded recovery after HEAD advances when purpose is implementation_rework. For an original implementation interrupted after the newly added pre-verification artifact commit, the selected recorded implementationCommit still reaches prepareDirectImplementationEvidence with recoveredExecutionBase=null; that helper observes current HEAD and can rebind provenance to the task-artifact commit. Add a direct replay regression for the first implementation and retain its original SHA and execution base through the same proven recovery owner. Evidence: .agentplane/tasks/202609042327-PH5N6S/quality/objects/sha256/42b69a9452a501af93217121d25f278df44ff056b94131e0829d7a04bd671bf4.patch.
findings.broken_invariant: External EVALUATOR review requires evidence-backed semantic judgement.

findings.summary: P2: run-cli.core.task-advance.branch-worktree.test.ts captures implementation from git rev-parse HEAD after the injected pre-verification interruption. With the new task-artifact commit, this is not the implementation SHA. The targeted existing test now fails at its recovery assertion near line 465, while the before-WorkItem-projection case passes. Bind the assertion to the recorded original implementation and explicitly distinguish the artifact HEAD. Evidence: .agentplane/tasks/202609042327-PH5N6S/quality/objects/sha256/42b69a9452a501af93217121d25f278df44ff056b94131e0829d7a04bd671bf4.patch.
findings.broken_invariant: External EVALUATOR review requires evidence-backed semantic judgement.

hidden_assumptions: The added advanced-HEAD recovery condition assumes only implementation_rework needs provenance recovery after the supervisor task-artifact commit, although the same commit is made for ordinary implementation.
recovery_context: Use a fresh bounded implementation packet.
